item.title: Warframe: Tau Gameplay Demo
item.description: This year's TennoLive mainstage presentation took us beyond the limits of the Origin System to Tau, a place that until now has only existed in our collective dreams (and of course, memories via The Old Peace). Community Director Megan Everett guided Tenno through their first foray into Warframe's first ENTIRELY NEW star system, which will include fresh worlds to explore as ongoing cinematic narrative flourishes in a massive new region beyond anything you've ever known.

item.title: Notice:Partial Revisions to Passive Texts for Dawn Office Fixer Faust&Rep Gregor
item.description:
Hello, this is Project Moon.

We have identified that the phrasing in some of the textual descriptions of Dawn Office Fixer Faust's Passive, "Seonbae", and Dawn Office Rep Gregor's Passive, "Dawn Office", may be interpreted ambiguously.

The Passive effects above are designed to be applied and converted not only when Dawn Office Fixer Faust and Dawn Office Rep Gregor are defeated in the current Encounter, but also when they are already defeated in the previous Encounter.
